verses.ar: أَحْبَبْتُ لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يَسْمَعُ صَوْتِي، تَضَرُّعَاتِي.
verses.en: I love that the LORD should hear my voice and my supplications.
verses.kjv: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications.
verses.web: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ أَمَالَ أُذْنَهُ إِلَيَّ فَأَدْعُوهُ مُدَّةَ حَيَاتِي.
verses.en: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, therefore will I call upon Him all my days.
verses.kjv: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon [him] as long as I live.
verses.web: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

verses.he: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי ׀ חֶבְלֵי־מָ֗וֶת וּמְצָרֵ֣י שְׁאֹ֣ול מְצָא֑וּנִי צָרָ֖ה וְיָגֹ֣ון אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.ar: ٱكْتَنَفَتْنِي حِبَالُ ٱلْمَوْتِ. أَصَابَتْنِي شَدَائِدُ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ. كَابَدْتُ ضِيقًا وَحُزْنًا.
verses.en: The cords of death compassed me, and the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.he: וּבְשֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֶקְרָ֑א אָנָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַלְּטָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.ar: وَبِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ دَعَوْتُ: «آهِ يَارَبُّ، نَجِّ نَفْسِي!».
verses.en: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'
verses.kjv: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.web: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

verses.en: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is compassionate.
verses.kjv: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God [is] merciful.
verses.web: Yahweh is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פְּתָאיִ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה דַּ֝לֹּותִ֗י וְלִ֣י יְהֹושִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.en: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
verses.kjv: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.web: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

verses.he: שׁוּבִ֣י נַ֭פְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָ֑יְכִי כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה גָּמַ֥ל עָלָֽיְכִי׃
verses.ar: ٱرْجِعِي يَا نَفْسِي إِلَى رَاحَتِكِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيْكِ.
verses.en: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.web: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

verses.he: כִּ֤י חִלַּ֥צְתָּ נַפְשִׁ֗י מִ֫מָּ֥וֶת אֶת־עֵינִ֥י מִן־דִּמְעָ֑ה אֶת־רַגְלִ֥י מִדֶּֽחִי׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْقَذْتَ نَفْسِي مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ، وَعَيْنِي مِنَ ٱلدَّمْعَةِ، وَرِجْلَيَّ مِنَ ٱلزَّلَقِ.
verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
verses.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, [and] my feet from falling.
verses.web: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.ar: أَسْلُكُ قُدَّامَ ٱلرَّبِّ فِي أَرْضِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ.
verses.en: I shall walk before the LORD in the lands of the living.
verses.kjv: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
verses.web: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

verses.he: הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אֲ֝נִ֗י עָנִ֥יתִי מְאֹֽד׃
verses.en: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'
verses.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.web: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

verses.ar: أَنَا قُلْتُ فِي حَيْرَتِي: «كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ كَاذِبٌ».
verses.en: I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'
verses.kjv: I said in my haste, All men [are] liars.
verses.web: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

verses.ar: مَاذَا أَرُدُّ لِلرَّبِّ مِنْ أَجْلِ كُلِّ حَسَنَاتِهِ لِي؟
verses.en: How can I repay unto the LORD all His bountiful dealings toward me?
verses.kjv: What shall I render unto the LORD [for] all his benefits toward me?
verses.web: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

verses.ar: كَأْسَ ٱلْخَلَاصِ أَتَنَاوَلُ، وَبِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أَدْعُو.
verses.en: I will lift up the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.web: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

verses.ar: أُوفِي نُذُورِي لِلرَّبِّ مُقَابِلَ كُلِّ شَعْبِهِ.
verses.en: My vows will I pay unto the LORD, yea, in the presence of all His people.
verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
verses.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

verses.ar: عَزِيزٌ فِي عَيْنَيِ ٱلرَّبِّ مَوْتُ أَتْقِيَائِهِ.
verses.en: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
verses.kjv: Precious in the sight of the LORD [is] the death of his saints.
verses.web: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

verses.he: אֽ͏ָנָּ֣ה יְהוָה֮ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֪י עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲ‍ֽנִי־עַ֭בְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶ֑ךָ פִּ֝תַּ֗חְתָּ לְמֹוסֵרָֽי׃
verses.ar: آهِ يَارَبُّ، لِأَنِّي عَبْدُكَ! أَنَا عَبْدُكَ ٱبْنُ أَمَتِكَ. حَلَلْتَ قُيُودِي.
verses.en: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.
verses.kjv: O LORD, truly I [am] thy servant; I [am] thy servant, [and] the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.web: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

verses.he: לְֽךָ־אֶ֭זְבַּח זֶ֣בַח תֹּודָ֑ה וּבְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֶקְרָֽא׃
verses.ar: فَلَكَ أَذْبَحُ ذَبِيحَةَ حَمْدٍ، وَبِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أَدْعُو.
verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.kjv: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.web: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD, yea, in the presence of all His people;
verses.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
verses.web: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

verses.he: בְּחַצְרֹ֤ות ׀ בֵּ֤ית יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽתֹ֘וכֵ֤כִי יְֽרוּשָׁלָ֗͏ִם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: فِي دِيَارِ بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ، فِي وَسَطِكِ يَا أُورُشَلِيمُ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.en: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
verses.kjv: In the courts of the LORD’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
